payload.summary: Real-app sweep, first attempt: the sweep agent REFUSED CLEANLY — qa-lane.md was not installed in the PR #24 worktree (orchestrator miss: pop-quiz got it, this target did not). The agent verified every other premise, ran the safe read-only baseline (236/236 tests, tsc clean), explicitly declined to invent the missing workflow or write guessed-shape state into a real store, and offered three unblock options. This is the hk0wvqhq fail-inside-the-flow behavior arriving for free from workflow discipline — the exact opposite of the codex kick-out incident. Resolved via option 1: orchestrator installed qa-lane.md (untracked in the worktree; the install lands on the projects default branch as its own act), sweep resumed with the epics existing qa item 294bekyd as its work item. Lesson filed for the lane: target-repo workflow installation belongs in the sweeps preconditions (charter step already checks doctor; it should also check the lane doc exists and park cleanly — which is precisely what happened, unscripted).
